name: io.cardos/cardos-mcp
description: Issue and manage virtual cards via the CardOS API — sandbox-first, money-safe.

environmentVariables.name: CARDOS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CardOS API key. A cms_sk_test_… key runs in sandbox (no real money). Get one at https://cardos.dev/partner/developers

environmentVariables.name: CARDOS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default https://cardos.dev/api/v1).
